dimensions.note: Section 1 states operating motives (the attributed watch duty, waiting, fear of renewed separation, desire for particular recognition, privileging the claimed master's own wishes) and a six-row competing-explanations table with an unresolved discriminator for each (infallible recognition, pure obedience, harmless affection, pure theater, innocence versus calculation, scorpion identity); section 4 gives twenty-five conditional rules with triggers, falsifiers and confidence. Every motive is read from her outward speech and conduct and from Subaru's focal account: the model leaves her reading of the dinner debate, her library inference and her reason for disliking the Green Room open, and none of the six discriminators is resolved, so B is not supported; the rival readings, falsifiers and state-bound rules exceed distributed description, so D is not supported.

Section 2 gives a selector of thirteen states (S0-S11 with S6a/S6b, plus SX) bound to events E021-E027, with separate holders for her reported memory, Subaru's discarded experience and the narrative's E026 encounter, and it refuses extension beyond V23. The witnessed span is a few days in one location across returns: S0 is attributed report, S7 is a corpse, SX gives no personal state, and the states record changing knowledge and encounters rather than development, so B is not supported; the located, event-bound selector exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

Section 6 gives a state-conditioned printed-Japanese register with loci: あーし and お師様 at V21 part0014 B0575-0605, ぷい～ッス and the switch after permission at V22 part0009 B0121-0133, 様 and 女史 at B0145-0148, ダメッスよ at B0620, the hedge らしい at V22 part0011 B0296, panic and 棒振り in V22 part0012, the forgetting remark recurring at V23 part0009 B0147 and part0010 B0127, and the katakana poses スコーピオンテール and the kiss-withdrawal catchphrase. The located inventory is about seven state rows of short tokens, the model asks for description first, marks any stylized line noncanonical, calls for abstention on unheard phrasing and new catchphrases and excludes any performed sound profile, so B is not supported; recipient- and state-conditioned self-reference, address, endings and hedging with loci exceed a described register, so D is not supported.

Section 5.1 and R17 locate a small set of ordinary acts: enjoying one substantial shared meal and asking Emilia to teach her cooking (V22 part0014), pride in her scorpion-tail styling, a stated dislike of the Green Room and awkwardness about the fourth floor, breakfast talk of food, sleep and a dream, and carrying Meili. R17 is MEDIUM because it rests on the single meal scene, and the model leaves a second-tasting preference, object placement, morning routine and room routine open, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

Section 5 separates eleven recipient roles with warranted operations and limits, and the rules give located contrasts: speech changing on Subaru's permission (R05) while Merope is still refused to him (R09); hug and kiss requests refused by Subaru and her withdrawal (R21); play, care and Meili's own hair-pull intervention (R16, R19); retreat under Ram's pressure (R15, MEDIUM); a cooking request to Emilia and later tactlessness toward Emilia and Beatrice (R17, R22); grief at Reid's death news and panic at his presence (R12, R13). Outside the claimed master, each relation rests on one or two exchanges within a few days, the historical master relation is attributed and unresolved, and R15, R17, R24 and R25 are MEDIUM, so B is not supported; explicit recipient-differentiated responses with countercases exceed generic description, so D is not supported.

The evidence gives no narrated access to Shaula's interior: the model states that she sees only Subaru's outward behavior, that her reading of the dinner debate, what she inferred in the library and what she did while away remain open, that the reason for her Green Room dislike is open, and that the whisper's meaning is unresolved. What remains is her own located testimony (waiting, fear of losing him again, embarrassment, the admitted performed appeal) and visible affect (shaking, faint, blush, tears), which supports bounded local questions only, so D is not supported; the model materially addresses the domain with located self-reports and explicit abstentions, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Rules locate varied conflict responses with falsifiers: severe ranged approach defense with lethal effects (R01, though the link to her is her later testimony), refusal of floor zero to the claimed master in friendly register (R09), a reported breach-override threat she hedges with らしい (R10), collapse into an actual faint under Reid (R13), complaint and hiding behind Subaru under Ram's challenge (R15, MEDIUM), a pout and performed protest at distance instructions (R19), and persisting with the book proposal after criticism (R22). Breach behavior is untested and only her testimony, the attribution of individual strikes is open and R15 is MEDIUM, so B is not supported; paired, located conflict cases with explicit exceptions exceed distributed description, so D is not supported.

The evidence locates morally loaded choices: the verbal nonharm promise beside her reported override risk (R08, R10), refusal of Merope even to the claimed master (R09), treating Meili's death as settled and recommending the book at the cost of tact (R22), and asking Subaru's own wish before accepting Beatrice's request (R23). It never shows her weighing competing claims: her inference and motives in R22 and R23 are left open, and her stance is reported or deferential rather than deliberated, so C is not supported; several located choices with countercases exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

Play is located across several states with conditioned functions: the ぷい～ッス silence pose before permission, teasing in the coin comparison, the immediate joke about lying after praising Subaru, numbering and reins play with Meili, pride in the スコーピオンテール styling, the performed sleepy appeal she later admits, the kiss-withdrawal pose catchphrase and the household joke that deflects the strained dinner (R24, MEDIUM). Most comic lines are paraphrased rather than quoted, R24 and R25 are MEDIUM, and the model refuses to infer fluency or provenance from the catchphrases, so B is not supported; repeated located instances with distinct functions (withholding, attention-seeking, face-saving, deflection) exceed a local mention, so D is not supported.

One curated item: the model, which systematically recovers her V21-V23 appearances through 28 contextual intervals, twenty-five evidence bundles (B01-B25) and seven stills. Her arc continues beyond the unopened V24, her E027 terminal state, historical identity, species and old knowledge are explicitly open, and the frozen readings, ledgers and separate fidelity review that would let the bundle locators be checked are not curated on her row, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of the whole admitted horizon exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and adverse controls: lethal approach effects against reading her as harmless (B01, B08), refusal of Merope even to the claimed master (B09), her own statement that she cannot read or write and is a poor choice for text search (B16, R07), actual incapacity under Reid (B12), Subaru's refusals of a hug and a kiss with her withdrawal (B20), the witnessed hurt her dismissal of Meili's death causes (B21), and the abstentions of section 7 and G01-G04. Several limits rest on her own testimony (illiteracy, no prior ascent above the fourth floor, the breach consequence), and rule detection is untested, so B is not supported; the located, witnessed countercases exceed generic caution, so D is not supported.

The default S11 is pinned to the E027 dinner after the personal request and book return and before the unreceived catastrophe, with what she has and has not received at that point (no amnesia disclosure in E027); each selector state is bound to an event, a recipient and a source locus, cross-return knowledge holders are separated and S7 and SX are fenced off from living speech. A is not supported because there are no in-world dates, S0 is attributed report and the terminal state after the E027 catastrophe is unresolved; C is not supported because the selector binds knowledge and receipt per event rather than giving a loose period label.

scenario_readiness.note: Section 7 supplies an application procedure (state, recipient, receipt, matching rule plus one adverse case, separation of noncanonical scenes), and G01-G04 bound use. Readiness is conditional because her motives are inferred from outward conduct, the witnessed span is a few days in one setting, four rules are MEDIUM and the review is same-analyst and nonblind. READY would treat a narrow tower-bound model as general; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound protocol with located rules.

The located ordinary social scenes are few: one substantial shared meal and cooking request (R17, MEDIUM), play and care with Meili (R16), teasing about styling (R25, MEDIUM) and a deflecting joke at the dinner (R24, MEDIUM). Section 5.1 explicitly leaves preferences after a second tasting, routines, room habits and object placement open. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social life from one meal and a dinner; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located scenes that the model treats with explicit limits.

The evidence locates outcomes of morally loaded choices (the nonharm promise, the Merope refusal, the blunt dismissal of Meili's death, asking Subaru's own wish) but never her weighing of them; the model leaves her inference and motives in R22 and R23 open and treats the breach consequence as her testimony. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the source withholds; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices and their countercases.

The evidence materially addresses and forecloses the domain: Subaru refuses both hug requests and blocks her kiss approach, his embrace has no renewed verbal assent narrated, R21 states the scene cannot decide a romantic relationship, general bodily permission or ownership, and G04 abstains from precise romance. CONDITIONAL would license romance framing the model rejects; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located refusals.

known_limits.statement: Her recognition of Subaru as master rests on criteria she reports herself (scent, poor face discrimination); the historical identity link to Flugel, the extent of her old knowledge, her species and her pre-tower history remain open, and the model abstains from Subaru-Flugel equality.

Shaula has no narrated interior in the evidence: her motives are inferred from her speech, conduct and Subaru's focal account, and her library inference, reading of the dinner debate, Green Room reason and the whisper's meaning are explicitly open.

S7 is a named corpse in a discarded E026 segment with the killer only Subaru's inference, and SX, the later E027 scorpion catastrophe, is evidence context with no identity bridge and no personally observed Shaula terminal state; neither supports living speech or action.

The four tower rules, the withdrawn fifth and the override of her nonharm promise on a breach are her report, with the detection wording hedged by らしい; no classified breach, trigger or resulting act is witnessed, and the axe impact while she is unconscious does not supply one.

Subaru refuses both hug requests and her kiss approach, and she withdraws; each touch decision is separate, earlier clinging does not authorize later contact, and no romantic relationship, general bodily permission or ownership is established.

The voice evidence is printed Japanese with ruby and selected stills; narrated vocal descriptions, typography and katakana catchphrases do not establish a performed sound profile, timing, phonetic or bilingual fluency, and exact unheard phrasing calls for abstention.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood. Its front matter still records publication_gate PENDING_THIS_OPERATION_FULL_GATE, while the project entrypoint, read for gate state only, records Shaula's full gate closed through PR #474; neither is a capability grade.

The frozen V21-V23 deep readings, the event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate Shaula fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's bundle locators and viewed stills were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
V24 and later are unopened; her arc continues past the E027 dinner and no later development, fate or knowledge is in evidence, so this assessment is bounded at V23.

known_limits.statement: Her recognition of Subaru as master rests on criteria she reports herself (scent, poor face discrimination); the historical identity link to Flugel, her old knowledge, her species and her pre-tower history remain open, and both models abstain from Subaru-Flugel equality.

Shaula never holds the viewpoint: her motives come from her speech, conduct and Subaru's focal account, with one narrated rescue intent in E030; her library inference, reading of the dinner debate and Green Room reason stay open, and comprehension, memory and command capacity after the transformation are UNKNOWN.

S7 is a named corpse in a discarded E026 segment; SX, SX28, S13 and the default S14e are observed scorpion action, with the identity bridge strengthened by companion sensing and the visible E030 transformation but purpose and retained cognition open; none supports living speech, and earlier killings keep their own attribution.

The four rules are her report with the detection wording hedged by らしい; the fifth, disclosed only in E030, permits destroying the Trial. She reports that someone broke a rule as symptoms begin, but the breaker, the classified act, the precise rule and the efficacy of her proposed death command remain open.

Her E030 willingness to die if told is an answer to a hypothetical question, and her later appeal for a death command is never answered with an issued command; neither establishes general obedience, and her deliberate fifth-rule refusal is a direct countercase to complete obedience.

Subaru refuses both hug requests and her kiss approach and she withdraws; Meili objects to her abrupt embrace; each touch decision is separate, earlier clinging or affection does not authorize later contact, and no romantic relationship, general bodily permission or ownership is established.

The voice evidence is printed Japanese with ruby and selected stills; narrated vocal descriptions, typography and katakana catchphrases do not establish a performed sound profile, timing, phonetic or bilingual fluency, and exact unheard phrasing calls for abstention.

Each model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood. Both models' front matter still records publication_gate PENDING_THIS_OPERATION_FULL_GATE, while the project router, read for gate state only, records the V21-V23 gate closed through PR #474 and the V21-V24 gate through PR #491; neither is a capability grade.
